description: This file defines a React-like component for creating a new note in a note-taking application. It manages note state, handles user input, and saves the note via API calls, integrating with the application's layout and navigation.

methods.name: onChangeTitle$
methods.description: Updates the note title in the component state.

methods.name: onChangeContent$
methods.description: Updates the note content in the component state.

methods.name: onChangeTags$
methods.description: Updates the note tags in the component state.

methods.name: onSave$
methods.description: Saves the current note via API and navigates to the note's page.
